Message.En:
You can <COL ffdc78>[Cling]</COL> to medium-large enemies. Make
sure to check the guide on the bottom right to
confirm which techniques and
actions will change.
[Cling] Approach the enemy and [<KC TOUCH>] [Actions from
clinging] Actions, such as attacking, while
clinging [<KC ATTACK1>] Actions, such as shaking,
while clinging [<KC CLIMB JOLT>].
Message.Jp:
中～大型の敵には<COL ffdc78>《しがみつき》</COL>が可能です
技や行動も変わるため右下のガイドで確認しましょう
＜しがみつき＞
　敵に近付いて【<KC TOUCH>】
＜しがみつきからの行動＞
　しがみついた状態で【<KC ATTACK1>】攻撃など
　しがみついた状態で【<KC CLIMB_JOLT>】揺さぶり
